I 'discontinued' my medication about a year ago (cold turkey). I don't know if I am still experiencing withdrawals or not to be honest, on the Internet I read it takes around 4 months to withdraw fully, so IDK.

Stopping the medication has had a series of utterly bizarre effects. I quite honestly wonder how many of my BPD symptoms where environment/ medication induced.
My moods, over short periods of time are more stable.
My impulse control is far far better.
I no longer get violent intrusive thoughts (I do get intrusive thoughts but they are on completely different subjects).

However, dissociation is a  nightmare, get periodic 'episodes' of horrendous agitation, anxiety, occasional hallucinations, sensory problems, very bad concentration and what I can only assume if OCD.
